sections.title: باب 7 — متن (69)

paras.text: For dribbling, keep the ball close to the body and dribble the ball while bending the knees. Do not hit the ball on the court with force; in this way the ball can easily be snatched from your possession. Remember that after dribbling, when the ball becomes stationary in your hand, then pass it; dribbling a second time is a foul.

sections.theory:
Dribbling

For dribbling, keep the ball close to the body and dribble the ball while bending the knees. Do not hit the ball on the court with force; in this way the ball can easily be snatched from your possession. Remember that after dribbling, when the ball becomes stationary in your hand, then pass it; dribbling a second time is a foul.

Method of dribbling

Passing with the wrist

When defending players come in front of some player in such a way that he can neither play the ball towards the goal nor pass to his player in front, then he can give a pass to the side with the wrist. To make this pass the player brings one foot forward and, the hand in which the ball is, bringing it close to the body, passes with force towards the outside.

Trying to snatch the ball

To snatch the ball use the hands; the torso can be used to stop the opposing players, provided there is no danger of the opposing player being injured by it.
